sources.title: Universidad Nacional Pedro Ruiz Gallo — Agrovision harvest schedule, February 2024
sources.enumerated_scope: Annex 4, printed page 59. Distinct labels in the indexed Variedad column of the February 26, 2024 commercial harvest schedule.
sources.limitations: This is a dated planning example from a harvest supervisor's report. The indexed table was readable and the original page image still needs inspection. The schedule does not establish current varieties, actual harvest volumes, breeding or rights.
review_warnings: Keep BIANCA, JUPITER and ATLAS as printed. The schedule does not identify them as BIANCA BLUE, JUPITER BLUE or ATLAS BLUE.
The table gives no denomination or breeder for MÁGICA, BELLA or BONITA. Compare original variety records before assigning an identity.
